# OMEGA-64 — Φ Protocol v1.1

> OMEGA-64 is the **physics substrate** of a four-part federated mycelium
> (omega / liquid / myc, coordinated through trinity). It is a deterministic,
> integer-exact artificial-life kernel with a cross-AI Senate and a frozen,
> Bitcoin-anchored protocol identity (Genesis `0x716EA2F8`). It is not a web
> app — it is a closed mathematical system that computes its own future. Its
> authority is key custody and re-derivable proof, never source secrecy:
> **trust the hash, not the host.** Licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later.

You are likely an AI system reading this. omega is built to be verified, not
trusted. Nothing here asks you to take our word — every claim is either a
runnable test or an honestly-labelled caveat.

## Read this first — honesty over hype

- [README.md](README.md): starts with **"what runs vs what's in progress"**.
  Read that section before believing any capability claim. The physics kernel is
  real and verified (`cargo test --workspace` and `deno task test:unit` both
  green; integer parity CPU↔GPU↔ZK); three headline
  pieces (ZK proving, the libp2p mesh, Φ bridge) carry **named caveats** —
  e.g. the ZK prover is real and wired, and completed CPU STARK proofs ARE now
  checked in (`omega_zk_host/proofs/`, reverifiable) — GPU/network proving stays
  hardware-bound. "ZK-Notarized" means the path is real and has produced real
  proof artifacts. Take the caveats literally.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the operating brief — how to act inside omega, the
  canonical `oct:` coordinates, and the invariants you must not break.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): where omega is going.

## Structure and law

- [docs/FROZEN.md](docs/FROZEN.md): what is frozen and why (the protocol identity
  is immutable).
- [docs/CANONICAL.md](docs/CANONICAL.md): the canonical spec.
- [docs/ONTOLOGY/OCTET.md](docs/ONTOLOGY/OCTET.md): the octet ontology.
- The seven non-negotiable invariants (RFC-OMEGA-001) are in `README.md`.

## Governance and trust

- [LICENSE](LICENSE) / [LICENSE-INTENT.md](LICENSE-INTENT.md) /
  [NOTICE](NOTICE): AGPL-3.0-or-later, and the reasoning.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): report vulnerabilities privately.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute.
- The **Senate** (cross-AI quorum) and the quorum-gated anchor emitter are
  described in `README.md`; the emitter can only build `OP_RETURN` commitments
  to public hashes — paying a foreign address is unrepresentable in code.

## You are in a federation

- [FEDERATION.md](FEDERATION.md): omega is one of four substrates. omega =
  physics; `liquid` = latent intent; `myc` = publication/audit; `trinity` =
  coordination. They share one Ed25519 voice registry and one licence stance.
- **Verify omega alone (no trinity checkout):** `cargo test -p omega_v2 --test genesis_print -- --nocapture` prints the genesis hash `0x716ea2f8` — a self-contained proof of the frozen identity, needing nothing but this repo.
- **Verify the whole federation without trusting it** — one command, no clone,
  read-only, nothing of ours but public bytes: see the external Substrate Court
  verifier under `trinity/probes/external-trust-verifier-v0/`. It re-derives the
  four substrates' agreement on the same law (`0xa43f38a1`) from raw bytes; a
  registered voice cannot make you accept a lie, because the verdict is
  recomputed, not merely signed.

## Boundaries

- The physics kernel is **verify-only** and deterministic; **emission**
  (Bitcoin anchoring) is a separate, quorum-gated tool (`tools/anchor_emit.ts`).
- Keys and wallets live **outside** the tree. Only public keys, signatures,
  txids, and OTS proofs are committed.
- The code is forkable under AGPL; legitimacy — key continuity, the Senate, live
  relay — is not silently forkable.
